_sources.soil: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998), table 19: middle of the ranges of soil water at field capacity and wilting point. Clay loam lies between silt loam and clay. Potting mix is not in FAO-56: typical peat-based substrate (assumption, D-026).
_sources.landscape_coefficient: WUCOLS IV (University of California): very low < 0.1, low 0.1-0.3, moderate 0.4-0.6, high 0.7-0.9; the middle of each class.
_sources.lawn: UC ANR (cool-season turfgrass in a temperate climate) about 0.8.
_sources.vegetable: FAO-56 table 12, typical small vegetables: Kc ini 0.6, mid 1.05, end 0.85; stage lengths simplified to 30 and 90 days after planting.
_sources.root_depth_m: Effective root zone for watering, simplified from FAO-56 table 22 for garden plants (assumption, D-026).
_sources.depletion_fraction: FAO-56 table 22: p about 0.5 for most crops, 0.4 for shallow-rooted vegetables.
_sources.rain: Interception and runoff: the first 2 mm of a day wet leaves and surfaces, 80 % of the rest reaches the roots (assumption, D-026).
